newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas utraded, OTC market also quiet and stable.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas utraded, OTC market also quiet and stable.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Tuesday morning as dealing got off to a slow start.

Bids were posted in all twelve contract months but offers were only seen in seven of them. In months with both bids and offers, in all cases they straddled the previous settlement price by the close of the two-hour morning session.
The physical market was also quiet, a trader said.
A trade was heard at 11.30 pence a therm for 28-30 May for 50,000 therms a day at the NBP, and there was some interest seen on the prompt market but outer periods were thinly discussed.
On the flexibility mechanism, there was some system selling seen on Saturday at a marginal price below 9.00 pence a therm, but no further trade was done over the long weekend or on Tuesday morning.
